headline_seed: King and Queen lay flowers at 9/11 Memorial in New York
description_seed: King Charles and Queen Camilla on their state visit to the US visit the memorial in New York.

what: King and Queen lay flowers at 9/11 Memorial in New York

clean_source_blocks.text: King Charles and Queen Camilla laid flowers at the September 11 Memorial in New York, in a sombre moment during their state visit to the United States.
King Charles and Queen Camilla on their state visit to the US visit the memorial in New York.

As part of his four-day trip to the U.S. to commemorate America's 250th birthday, King Charles III and Queen Camilla took part in a wreath-laying event at the 9/11 Memorial & Museum in New York City on Wednesday. It was Charles' first state visit to the U.S. as king.
King Charles and Queen Camilla left New York City on Wednesday evening after the King's Trust gala at Rockefeller Center.
